name: Volunteers
summary: Tamsin Ledger is enrolling the village militia in triplicate, and needs three signatures to make it lawful. Sergeant Gaunt has volunteered for the rear.

stages.journal: Tamsin Ledger set up a trestle desk in the Round to enrol the militia. It must be signed in triplicate by three named volunteers.
stages.hint: Collect signatures from Sergeant Gaunt, Ambrose Quill and Barnaby Pennywhistle, then take them to Tamsin.

stages.journal: Tamsin stamped the militia roll, three copies. The village has a lawful militia, and it is mostly Barnaby.
Tamsin tore up the forms: an unsigned militia cannot lawfully hold a barricade. The barricade will be held by whoever is standing there.
